value.rationale: Question 33 of arxiv:2610.22248 asks for a splitting classification in perfect evolution algebras; the exact F4 single-cycle subfamily provides a complete natural two-orbit classification and a sharp iff arithmetic splitting criterion, revealing nonsplit a cyclic group of order three times the half-dimension examples for every h divisible by 3 rather than only isolated low-dimensional constructions.
